summary: Make Bash login shells load the canonical ClawMobile Termux environment and remove non-activated RDC-specific environment wrappers.
reason: Live RDC evidence confirmed Desktop Commander executes bash -l -c while ClawMobile configured only ~/.bashrc; no login profile sourced it, leaving PREFIX/TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP empty.

tests.name: openclaw-login-shell
tests.evidence: test-openclaw-login-shell.sh passed against isolated fresh and existing-profile HOME directories with real bash -l -c.

tests.name: rdc-regression
tests.evidence: remote-desktop-watchdog 16/16, remote-desktop-health 9/9, RDC incident-loop 5/5, Claw Live 19/19, and incident runtime hardening passed.

tests.name: tier0-regression
tests.evidence: test-tier0-control.py passed 13/13 on the isolated candidate.

capabilities.reason: Restores the environment required by existing remote_desktop/device.adb execution without changing their scope or entrypoints.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing OpenClaw installer shell bootstrap; removes the non-activated RDC-specific workaround instead of adding a new owner.

rollback: Restore the exact pre-change login profile, revert the source commit, and promote the prior Tier-0 Last Known Good release.
limitations: No live payment is executed by this maintenance change.
Activation changes only the managed Bash login bootstrap after taking an exact local snapshot.
